description: ClawCall makes real US phone calls in English on your behalf. Ask businesses questions, arrange appointments within your instructions, or join a live call through your verified account phone. Follow call progress and review captured transcripts and available recordings. Manage your saved voice and personality, and configure an inbound assistant when your plan includes a private number and inbound calling. ClawCall screens call requests before dialing. Screening can use your instructions, account identity, and up to five recent outbound calls with available transcripts. ClawCall deletes transcripts 7 days after each call ends and recordings 10 minutes after each call ends. Learn more at https://clawcall.dev/call-screening and https://clawcall.dev/privacy.
